mechanism: Probenecid inhibits renal tubular secretion of sulfasalazine and its metabolite sulfapyridine, increasing their serum concentrations and risk of sulfonamide toxicity.
action: Monitor for sulfasalazine toxicity signs (nausea, vomiting, crystalluria, hemolytic anemia); consider alternative uricosuric agent or adjust sulfasalazine dosing if concurrent use is necessary.
